description: Persona is an identity verification and KYC platform. This plugin manages accounts and inquiries, approves or declines inquiries, marks them for review, runs inquiry sessions and one-time links, reads inquiry templates, configures webhooks with signing-secret rotation, and verifies inbound webhook deliveries with HMAC-SHA256.
